definitions.explanation: Refers to a person, typically in formal or written contexts. Often used in compounds or after a modifying clause to mean 'the one who' or 'a person who.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{者|もの}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧{入室|にゅうしつ}{可|か}。
⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧{者|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}て→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Those who are interested, please apply at the front desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{捕|つか}まっていない→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect in this case has not yet been caught.
examples.notes: In compounds, {者|しゃ} is the on'yomi reading. See note below.

notes:
{者|もの} means 'person' in formal or written contexts. It is distinct from ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing).

PRONUNCIATION:
- もの: standalone or in some native compounds — {者|もの}
- しゃ: in Sino-Japanese compounds — ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧ (doctor), ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ (scholar), ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ (reporter)

COMMON COMPOUNDS (しゃ reading):
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: patient
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: suspect
- ⟦{希望者|きぼうしゃ}→希望者：03050_kibousha⟧: applicant, person who wishes
- ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧: person involved, authorized person
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: young person

CONTRAST WITH {人|ひと}:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ is the general, everyday word for 'person'
- {者|もの} is more formal or literary and often appears in official or legal contexts
